load_warnings: DQ-001: One AppID is stored in Excel scientific notation '1.50E+10' in Owner_Details and Persistency_Details. It is the only 8-character AppID in either file; every other AppID is 11 characters.

DQ-002: Both Policy date columns mix separators ('/' and '-') within the same column. All values are month-first; the dash-separated subset is ambiguous on its own and was resolved by cross-validation.
